- **B10 · Parent or legal guardian** — Leave blank if you are an adult applying for yourself. If applicable, NEEDS-YOU for the parent or guardian’s name, address if different, phone, email, and nationality.

- **B20 · Residence outside the country of current nationality** — If you reside in Singapore, tick **Yes** and enter **Employment Pass**. NEEDS-YOU for the pass number and expiry date. If you reside in the Philippines, tick **No**.
- **B21 · Current occupation** — Staff nurse.
- **B22 · Employer** — NEEDS-YOU for your employer’s name, address, and telephone number.
- **B23 · Purpose of journey** — Tick **Tourism**.
- **B24 · Additional information on purpose of stay** — Holiday in Italy, arriving in Rome on 14 May 2027 and leaving the Schengen area on 28 May 2027.
- **B25 · Main destination** — Italy. NEEDS-YOU for any other Schengen destinations on your itinerary.
- **B26 · Member State of first entry** — Italy.
- **B27 · Number of entries requested** — Tick **Single entry** if you want one entry for the trip described. NEEDS-YOU to select **Two entries** or **Multiple entries** if you want either of those.
- **B28 · Intended arrival** — 14-05-2027.
- **B29 · Intended departure** — 28-05-2027.
- **B30 · Previous Schengen visa fingerprints** — Tick **No**. Leave the date and visa sticker number blank.
- **B31 · Entry permit for final destination** — If applicable, NEEDS-YOU for the issuer and the validity start and end dates. Otherwise leave blank.
- **B32 · Host or accommodation name** — NEEDS-YOU for the name of each host, hotel, or other temporary accommodation, as applicable.
- **B33 · Host or accommodation contact details** — NEEDS-YOU for the corresponding address, email, and telephone number.
- **B34 · Inviting company or organisation** — Leave blank if you have no inviting company or organisation. If applicable, NEEDS-YOU for its name and address.
- **B35 · Inviting company contact details** — If B34 applies, NEEDS-YOU for the contact person’s surname, given name, address, phone, and email, plus the company’s phone number. Otherwise leave blank.
- **B36 · Travel and living costs** — Tick **by the applicant himself/herself**. NEEDS-YOU to select the means of support you will use. Leave the sponsor section blank.
- **B37 · Person filling in the form** — Leave blank if you complete the application yourself. Otherwise, NEEDS-YOU for the preparer’s surname and given name.
- **B38 · Preparer’s contact details** — If B37 applies, NEEDS-YOU for the preparer’s address, email, and telephone number. Otherwise leave blank.
- **B39 · Place and date** — NEEDS-YOU. Enter the place and date of signing.
- **B40 · Signature** — NEEDS-YOU. Sign the form yourself and obtain a parent or legal guardian’s signature if applicable.

If you qualify for the family-member exemption printed at the top of the form, leave **B21, B22, and B32–B36** blank.
